answer.rationale: With contract expiry in 14 days, no auto-renewal, and the line at 94% committed volume without buffer, a primary-vendor switch would introduce unverified delivery and migration risk. The incumbent has maintained integration and delivery continuity, while the low-cost vendor memory establishes savings and quick onboarding but not dependable supply under near-capacity conditions. Renew now to protect production; the 18% savings gap remains unresolved and should be addressed in the next review.
